contractions: Euclidean coordinate transpose; h weights are included explicitly in objective gradients. No unstated weighted-adjoint identification.

solver.nonlinear_initial: zero interior state for every Bratu base/FD solve; no cross-run warm starts

gmres.algorithm: Reviewed callable-only right-preconditioned GMRES with two-pass modified Gram-Schmidt; no state Jacobian assembly in primary derivative path.
gmres.preconditioner: Constant Poisson A_h^-1, homogeneous Dirichlet, Thomas factorization; no parameter-dependent approximation to J.
gmres.retention_adaptation: Reuse the current reviewed GMRES numerical body byte-identically; external nonmutating operator/outer-state checkpoint wrappers and result-status interpretation only. No new target/floor,stopping rule,precision or iteration.

diffusion-discrete-adjoint.boundary: Fixed zero Dirichlet; state and parameter sensitivities zero at endpoints.
diffusion-discrete-adjoint.linear_solver: Actual tridiagonal backward-Euler Thomas solve and transpose solve; cache one factorization per(n,N,kappa).

storage_accounting.40n_scope: Peak UNIQUE owning float64 elements in evolving checkpoint/trajectory/current or replayed state,adjoint,RHS,forward-elimination/back-substitution RHS/output scratch. Views count their owning root once,not zero and not twice. All live aliases are inventoried.
storage_accounting.40n_excludes_but_reports: Static tridiagonal coefficients/factorization/pivots and fixed model/forcing/coordinate/target arrays,reference-validation arrays and other numeric work are NOT absorbed into the40n state-buffer limit. Every such live array is still included in the separate total-owned-numeric-byte ledger.
storage_accounting.separate_total_requirement: At N256,checkpoint total peak owned numeric bytes INCLUDING static factors,all solve work,model arrays and any live reference/evidence buffers must be strictly smaller than full-storage total measured in its separate ownership window. Equal/common factors are included in BOTH windows.
storage_accounting.ownership_windows: Serialize and release full-storage trajectory/aliases/closures before checkpoint window;no fulltrajectory mmap or live validation cache hidden outside ledger. Assemble validationNPZ only AFTER the claimed ownership measurement window;streamed file bytes are identified separately from resident numeric buffers.
storage_accounting.failure: If source allocation inventory cannot establish these categories and both limits,fail the storage gate. No retrospective exclusion of an inconvenient buffer.

bratu-fold-sensitivity.input_rounding: Each lambda_decimal is converted once to binary float; independent cache evaluates exactly that float via Decimal.from_float. Anchors are checked against high-precision discrete fold, not treated as exact.
bratu-fold-sensitivity.branch: Strict positive lower branch: symmetric state, positive smallest J eigenvalue; actual lambda below qualified discrete fold.
bratu-fold-sensitivity.linear_reference: Separate scipy.linalg.solve_banded direct tangent/transpose solves at the SAME actual float state, with their own residuals reported.
bratu-fold-sensitivity.sigma: Smallest absolute eigenvalue of symmetric tridiagonal J using scipy.linalg.eigh_tridiagonal in reference/diagnostic window; floating estimate, not an interval-certified lower bound.

linear_result_policy.scope: Only the case63 derivative tolerance study; nonlinear state requirements and other case scientific thresholds unchanged.
linear_result_policy.target_met: Exactly actual_true_residual<=requested_absolute_target; raw_solver_passed must equal this decision. Never set true because the candidate is accurate against an independent reference.

required_targets.1e-4: Both tangent and adjoint MUST meet the actual requested true-residual target within120iterations.
required_targets.1e-8: Both tangent and adjoint MUST meet the actual requested true-residual target within120iterations.

linear_result_policy.tight_requested_1e_12: An OBSERVATIONAL diagnostic target. Keep the exact returned last candidate,its actual residual and full history. Unmet target is explicitly UNMET,never renamed converged. No direct-reference replacement,best-iterate selection,fallback,extra iterations or retry.
linear_result_policy.termination_reason: target_met if true;otherwise maximum_iterations when iterations==120,arnoldi_breakdown when returned early with rawpassedfalse;exception/nonfinite is a failure. Preserve raw reason separately from roundoff interpretation.
linear_result_policy.roundoff_estimate: Diagnostic only:unitroundoff u=2^-53,gamma12=12u/(1-12u);scale_i=(2/h^2+|c_i|)|x_i|+(|x_(i-1)|+|x_(i+1)|)/h^2+|rhs_i|,c_i=lambda*exp(u_state_i),zero endpoint x. rho_est=||gamma12*scale||2. This accounts approximately for stencil arithmetic,not a certified total error bound or exp error theorem.
linear_result_policy.roundoff_diagnostic: If target unmet and residual<=10*rho_est,label UNMET_ROUNDOFF_SCALE_CONSISTENT,cause_not_proven. Otherwise UNMET_ABOVE_ROUNDOFF_ESTIMATE. Keep maximum_iterations/breakdown as independent termination fields. Zero-scale ratios use explicit validity/category,never NaN/Inf.
linear_result_policy.case_success_meaning: The same141case-gate inventory may pass only when required1e-4/1e-8targets,all finite saved candidates,independent shooting-gradient1e-8accuracy and same-state corrected identities/bounds all pass. It does NOT mean that the1e-12diagnostic solve converged.

bratu-distributed-vjp.coefficient: a(x)=2+Btheta; linear partition-unity endpoint hats. Main cases1.7<=a<=2.3.
bratu-distributed-vjp.primary_basis_storage: Two indices and two weights per state node; Bv gather/interpolation and B^T w scatter-add. No n-by-m B or sensitivity in primary.
bratu-distributed-vjp.boundary: u(0)=u(1)=0 and du/dtheta endpoints0. Coefficient controls at endpoints are not fixed-zero Dirichlet parameters.
counter_modes: three-objective:three separate adjoint RHS on same already solved state

affine_control.scope: Coefficient identity only; these values are not the main1.7..2.3coefficient-bound cases.

bratu-distributed-vjp.reference: Separate directly evaluated dense hat formula and banded J solve of all m tangent RHS; explicitly allowed only in independent reference window. Same discrete model, not separate forward PDE truth.
